payload.name: Binocular Advantage in Reading
payload.fact: Binocular viewing facilitates lexical processing during Chinese sentence reading compared to monocular viewing, resulting in shorter fixation durations.
payload.boundary: Observed in Chinese sentence reading and attributed to both foveal information encoding and parafoveal preprocessing.

provenance.title: Are There Binocular Advantages in Chinese Reading? Evidence from Eye Movements
provenance.quote_or_locus: the results indicated that compared with monocular viewing, binocular viewing resulted in shorter fixation durations, thereby facilitating lexical processing
